summary.rule: Primary lexical gate: the bounded 104-record elementary-school lexical source is known before junior-high; productive inflections of those bases remain grammar-gated. Explicit proper-name allowances are honored only inside the current passage when allowedWords marks the row proper names and the actual token is capitalized; those names are never promoted into cumulative ordinary vocabulary. All remaining lexical items use canonical v7 textbook+grade+PDF/subunit chronology. Closed contractions and a bounded explicit structural/function set are handed to grammar chronology. Productive surface forms are reduced to a canonical v7 base and handed to grammar chronology. For v7-absent tokens, reviewed app allowedWords may authorize only later passages. Capitalization alone never authorizes a proper noun.
